sam-sales: quick ask 500pm PT deadline6elta Holdings POC needs a short residency + subprocessor answers. highlights: they want to understand where model logs go, if they can BYOK per-tenant, and evidence for any human access to logs. can we assemble a short packet by EOD?
evan-se: quicks: Private = customer KMS, Dedicated = BYOK supported (we hold wrapped key), Hosted = Redwood KMS (no per-tenant CMK). we can offer tokenization/encryption plugins for hosted as an add-on.
clare-arch: sketch for diagram, i'll tidy and export after approvals:
```
Client -> Regional Ingress -> API Gateway -> Routing Layer -> Inference Fleet (GPU)
                              |-> Tenant-scoped KV cache (encrypted)
                              |-> KMS (Redwood or Customer per deployment)
Audit flow: access events -> immutable WORM store -> signed export -> customer SIEM
```
terry-security: metadata persisted = [request_id, model_name, timestamp, token_counts, processing_ms, tenant_id]. we DO NOT persist full input by default. manual access events are logged with actor, reason, timestamp, and are included in signed bundles on request.
mila-legal: Delta asked for monthly subproc list + 48h evidence for access logs. legal ok to offer 72h for evidence. if they want 48h we need enterprise addendum.
ci-bot: POC-DELTA-77 created; assigned to evan-se 

evans-se: i'll draft the one-pager + diagram and include subproc list. timeline EOD 3pm PT. clara can you produce sample signed audit bundle?
clare-arch: yes, will do. sample format = JSON with detached signature and verification steps.
terry-security: add note: cache isolation includes per-tenant namespaces and access control lists. we zero caches on scaling events.
sam-sales: great. pls mark as high priority.
